scope: Isolated synthetic fixtures; no owner data or browser storage

checks.name: Confirmed dated events aggregate across existing outfit modes without invented scores
Thirty-day range includes first and final dates; future entries are separately disclosed
All-recorded range excludes future dates, preserves older entries and leaves source untouched
Ninety-day inclusive start is a calendar date
Same date and exact outfit count as separate confirmed entries, one recorded day
Last recorded date uses dated chronology, not array insertion order
Old record is outside counts but still available as last-recorded evidence
Missing last-recorded date remains null, not never worn or a fabricated elapsed value
Leap-day arithmetic and daylight-saving dates use civil calendar differences
Earliest supported dates clamp range start rather than generating malformed years
Invalid date, unrecognized range and malformed ledger are rejected
Unconfirmed, mismatched, duplicate-ID, unsupported and REFERENCE records are rejected, not silently skipped
Source lock conflicts are rejected without using a different wardrobe
Image-sharing DS001/DS014, DS024/DS025 and DS021/DS047 retain independent physical counts
Different physical trouser IDs remain independent when their image color is shared
Matching suit trousers are not invented as separate physical pant events
Intentional No Tie and no watch are not garment IDs or fabricated utilization
Watches use exact existing IDs/names with no image requirement
Only stored repetition flags are counted; repeated outfits do not create extra incidents
All 50 shirts retained in Insights, with 18 non-suit connected and 32 deferred labels
Deferred DS041 can have a suit No Tie record without becoming a non-suit option
Search matches current names and exact stored identity text, without renaming
Factual count sort is stable for ties; default catalogue order is unchanged
Last-recorded sort puts unrecorded items last, not oldest by assumption
Recorded-only filtering means recorded in selected window, not before it
Unsupported groups, tampered report objects and invalid filters are rejected
Reports and roster are immutable; returned filtered rows cannot alter the model
Read-only calculation never touches browser storage, scores, session or Favorites
Current outfit and Favorites-only histories produce no wear metrics
Ledger reconciliation: counted + older + future equals original events
10,000-event supported ledger is counted without new scores or synthetic de-duplication
All existing garment, scorer, renderer, CSS, Favorites and storage sources are byte-identical
